title: Adding a Working Balance to a Paydown for an Account Left Short at the Till
content:
Where an Employee Meal Account is carrying too little stored value to get through an ordinary till transaction, an amount is added to the paydown so the employee leaves the desk able to eat. The heavy use multiple for this purpose is 2.

**Clause.** Where the stored value standing is below the single transaction ceiling printed against the plan and at least one meal of the employee's own has been rung on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the amount added to restore a working balance is the reload amount printed against the plan taken at the heavy use multiple. Where the stored value standing is below that single transaction ceiling and no meal of the employee's own has been rung on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the amount added is the reload amount printed against the plan. Where neither holds, nothing is added.

## The plan figures this reads

| Meal plan | Single transaction ceiling | Automatic reload amount |
|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | $25.00 | $0.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | $35.00 | $50.00 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | $30.00 | $25.00 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | $24.00 | $25.00 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | $20.00 | $0.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | $120.00 | $250.00 |

## The bands

| Stored value standing | Meals of the employee's own rung in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | Added to restore a working balance |
|---|---|---|
| Below the plan's single transaction ceiling | 1 or more | The plan's reload amount, doubled |
| Below the plan's single transaction ceiling | None | The plan's reload amount, once |
| At or above the plan's single transaction ceiling | Any | Nothing |

What is counted is meals of the employee's own, not guest meals and not allowance applications.

*Hypothetical illustration.* An account on a plan printing a $30.00 single transaction ceiling and a $25.00 reload amount, holding $12.00 of stored value, with 5 meals of the employee's own rung in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked: $25.00 taken at the multiple of 2 is $50.00 added. With no such meal in that month, $25.00 is added. Holding $31.00 of stored value on the same plan, nothing is added.
